text:
maya: heads-up — deploying model-service v2.3.4 in ~10m for change window. primary SLOs: p95 latency, 5xx rate, kv-cache errors. will kick off smoke when shift starts.

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: model-service:v2.3.4 -> prod. strategy: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 12m. change window: 2026-03-20T22:00Z-23:00Z. initiated by @maya.

sam-oncall: i'll watch EU-west and global SLO dashboards. if anything fires i'll post and escalate. :eyes: maintenance: quiet window for unrelated deploys?

leo-sre: recommendation: set mid-roll latency guard p95 > 1.0s for 5m to avoid noisy batch-induced pauses. pause condition: p95 > 1s (5m) OR 5xx > 0.5% (3m). rollback if sustained: p95 > 1.2s (10m) OR 5xx > 1% (5m) -> revert to v2.3.3.

jordan: applying the guard and adding a soft routing pin to favor stable nodes during ramp. updating rollout policy now.

maya: noted. adding rollback criteria to release notes and infra config.

release-bot: release notes published: https://intranet.redwood/release-notes/model-service/v2.3.4 (kv-cache invalidation fix, quant tweak, batch sizing change).

ops-agent: pre-roll smoke checklist to run at start:
```
curl -fsS https://prod.model-service/health | jq .
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/model-service
./scripts/check-slo --service model-service --window 5m
```

sre-bot: temporary alert created: ms_p95_midroll_guard -> notify #eng-oncall and escalate to @sam-oncall after 3m. runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/ms_midroll_guard

sam-oncall: acknowledged. i'll post status every 3m or on any alert.

maya: starting traffic shift -> 10% now. smoke tests running.

deploy-bot: traffic at 10% -> smoke ok. p95=450ms, 5xx=0.02%.

maya: advancing to 30%.

deploy-bot: traffic at 30% -> p95=710ms, 5xx=0.04%. no alerts.

leo-sre: watching tail. slight uptick but within margin.

maya: ramping to 60%.

deploy-bot: traffic at 60% -> p95=920ms, 5xx=0.15% (below pause). kv-cache errors unchanged.

sam-oncall: no firing alerts. dashboards look stable. posting snapshot: p50=120ms p95=920ms errors=0.15%

maya: final shift to 100% now.

deploy-bot: traffic 100% -> rollout complete. no pause/rollback triggered. marking change window success.

maya: thanks team. i'll add a short post-deploy note and close thread. reopen if late regressions crop up and tag oncall.
